en: Black‑and‑white historical postcard showing a crowded street parade with soldiers on horseback and many civilians. Young girls in traditional Alsatian dress walk in the foreground. The background features old timber‑framed buildings with signs, flags, and watching crowds at the windows. Caption text at the bottom identifies the scene as the solemn entry of Marshal Pétain into Strasbourg on 25 November 1918.
